name: The Year 2012
overview: Scripture reveals that the exact timing of end-time events, including the day and hour, is known only by the Father, as Jesus emphasizes in Matthew 24:36 and Mark 13:32. Signs such as wars, famines, pestilences, and earthquakes will precede the end, but these are not indicators that the final consummation has arrived (Matthew 24:6-7). Daniel 9:27 speaks of a covenant confirmed for a set period, followed by a time of desolation caused by abominations, pointing to a divinely appointed sequence of events leading to the ultimate fulfillment of God's plan. Thus, while many look for specific years like 2012, Scripture urges believers to remain watchful without setting dates, trusting in God's sovereign timing.
